questions.q: River velocity rises from 0.40 m/s to 0.70 m/s. What is the percentage increase?
questions.why: (0.30 ÷ 0.40) × 100 = 75%. Always divide by the original value.

questions.q: On a 1:25,000 map, 4 cm represents what real distance?
In fieldwork, what is an anomaly?
options: data that does not fit the pattern
questions.why: An anomaly is a result that does not fit the general pattern.

questions.q: Explain one way you managed a risk during your fieldwork.
questions.model: On the beach there was a risk of being cut off by the tide, so we checked tide times in advance and worked on a falling tide.
points: control measure that fits the risk
